ai_analysis.domain: Sales and stock management for a regional paper and office-supply distributor. Order lines (quantity, unit price) roll up to orders, customers and sales reps; a separate daily snapshot records inventory on hand per product. Both facts share one product and one date dimension.
objectives: Track revenue and units sold by product, category, customer and sales rep
Monitor stock levels over time and compare opening vs closing inventory
Understand each product's share of its category's volume
questions: What was revenue by product category last quarter?
Which sales rep sold the most units to customers in Pennsylvania?
What is the closing inventory balance for copy paper this month?
Which products contribute more than 20% of their category's quantity?

ai_instructions: Revenue is the primary sales measure; it is quantity × unit price, summed.
Inventory Balance and Opening Inventory are semi-additive — never sum them across dates; they take the last and first balance date in the period.
Date is a single shared calendar: grouping by Month splits order and inventory measures by the same month.
Unit Price is averaged, not summed.
